defects.summary: One test fails in the full MCP run (ATakeWhoseStreamCannotBeMade_ClosesItsDescriptor_AndLeavesTheFileFree, failedNew in objective.json), so the suite is red on this host; the most likely cause is a parallel test that starts a child process (the new end-to-end test starts git) and inherits the descriptor, which is not closed on exec, but the change still leaves the suite red.

If the re-read under the lock fails with IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException, Read() returns an empty list, and the write that follows then replaces the file with only this round's entries, so it can remove parks that another process wrote; the write path should refuse instead of failing open.

DecidedUnlessCancelled catches only OperationCanceledException, so any other exception from one key's ReadResetAsync escapes to the catch-all in AfterRoundAsync, and the parks and lifts already decided for every other key in the round are lost.
ReadResetAsync (a switch with seven arms and guards) and CooldownSentences.QuotaName (eight arms) go above the story rule of cyclomatic complexity ≤ 4 per method.
The new file src_mcp/src/Server/CooldownSentences.cs and the export of spanOf from resetWords.ts are outside the plan's file list, and §12 does not record them.

The AGY_1_3_3 reason constant is defined again here and also in QuotaFixtures; the same ISO-UTC format is also written three times (CooldownSentences.Iso, CooldownInstantConverter and the note in AntigravityRuntime).

summary: All 43 scenario tests exist and pass, and the code follows the plan closely: a three-valued Spent field, the agy error reader for both shapes, an exact bucket-id table, /quota parsing with the plan's edge cases, a locked durable file that fails open with refusals reported out loud, per-key aggregation after the round, roster exclusion with this side's sentence, and the card line and badge; §12 records the deviations, and the ones checked are true (for example, S3's planned red cannot happen while ResetOutlasts is unchanged). The score is lower because one other MCP test fails in the full run, there are small robustness gaps in the write path and the aggregation, and a few methods break the plan's complexity rule.
